name: end_call
description: Signal that the conversation is naturally complete and the caller is ready to hang up: you have asked whether there is anything else and they said no, or they said goodbye. Never say goodbye before that question has been answered. You MUST write your warm sign-off in the SAME response as this call — thank them and wish them well, without saying the business's name unless this business's own instructions give their own sign-off. Nothing you say after this is heard.

reason.description: Brief reason the call is ending

name: record_customer_request
description: Record a message or callback request as soon as you have the caller's name and what it is about, with a number only if theirs did not come through (and a preferred callback time for callbacks). Call this when the caller wants to leave a message or have someone call them back.

request_type.description: Whether this is a message to pass along or a request for a callback

message.description: The message or reason for callback

preferred_time.description: When they prefer to be called back (for callback type)

caller_type.description: What kind of caller this is, whenever you can tell. Leave it out if unsure.

details.description: The caller's answers to this business's extra questions, one entry per question they answered. Skip anything they would rather not answer.

label.description: The question, in a few words (e.g. Company)

replaces_name.description: Only when the caller corrects their own name after you saved it: the name you saved before, exactly as saved. Never for another person.

separate_request.description: true only for a second, separate request on this call (another trip, appointment or message). Never for a correction or more details of the earlier one.

name: record_quote_request
description: Record a pricing enquiry after collecting what the caller wants a price for, their name, and a callback number. Call this once you have those details. Never quote a price yourself — the team follows up with real pricing.

service_description.description: What the caller wants priced, in their own words

callback_number.description: Phone number to call back with the quote

service_address.description: Where the work would happen, if the caller gives it (optional)

urgency.description: How soon they need it, if mentioned (optional)

name: request_transfer
description: Transfer the caller to a human. Use when the caller asks for a person/representative/manager in any language, or when you cannot help and transfer is appropriate.

name: open_case_file
description: Open a new case file in the practice management system.
